name: Poké Flute
description: A sweet-sounding flute that awakens Pokémon.

gifts.note:
Clear the Trick House puzzles (from Badge 4). The Trick House on Route 110 opens once you have the Lavaridge Gym badge (Badge 4). Find where the Trick Master is hiding in the entrance room, then go through the hole behind the scroll. He gives one reward at the end of each puzzle; leave the house and come back for the next one. Some puzzles need Cut, Rock Smash or Strength.
Puzzles 1–7: Gengarite, Tyranitarite, Mawilite, Garchompite, Audinite, Choice Specs, Choice Band.
Puzzle 8: Choice Scarf, a Red or Blue Tent decoration and the Poké Flute. Make room in your Bag first: these are not kept for you if it is full.
